newsitem.title: GERMANY: AEG fully integrated into Daimler.
newsitem.headline: AEG fully integrated into Daimler.

text.p: Germany's once venerable rail and engineering group AEG AG, which earlier this year announced plans to dissolve itself, on Friday became wholly integrated into its parent company Daimler-Benz AG.

In a statement Daimler-Benz, Germany's largest industrial conglomerate, said that the decision reached at AEG's shareholder meeting in June has now been formalised with AEG's remaining businesses run by the Daimler group.

AEG's railway system, micro-electronic and sorting system business units will now be managed directly by Daimler while the diesel motor business will be managed by Daimler's luxury car unit Mercedes-Benz.
Earlier this year AEG announced that its 1995 loss totalling 500 million marks -- too much to justify a rescue by Daimler-Benz -- forced management to take the decision to dissolve the company.
